experiment.name: Paired entropy versus random oracle-label simulation
experiment.acquisition: Training pool only; descending entropy with ID tie breaks, or seeded uniform random sampling.
experiment.evaluation_protocol: Validation curves at fixed budgets; one final sealed test evaluation per strategy per seed.
experiment.oracle_disclosure: Ground-truth training labels simulate annotation; no human annotation gains are measured.

metrics.ece: 10 equal-width top-label confidence bins; weighted absolute confidence-minus-accuracy gap
metrics.brier: mean sum of squared probability errors across 10 classes (range 0..2)

dataset.name: scikit-learn bundled digits
dataset.split_method: stratified 60/20/20 sample split; 100 stratified training seed labels
limitations: Small educational benchmark, not evidence of production performance.
Bundled samples are from the original UCI test partition, resplit here.
Sample splits are not writer-disjoint; writer identity is unavailable in the loader.
Interactive pool labels are hidden; simulation alone accesses oracle pool labels.
